info.title: REvoCompute API
info.description: Client API for discovering scientific runners, submitting tasks, monitoring execution, and retrieving results. Use POST /compute/api/auth/login, then copy the returned token into Authorize as a Bearer token. Long-lived API keys are created from the REvoCompute Profile page.

tags.name: Tools
tags.description: Authenticated, ephemeral, CPU-only scientific utilities executed outside Slurm.

tags.name: Runner fleet
tags.description: Admin-only Runner fleet readiness, typed operator planning, and Operator Jobs.

get.summary: Get the authoritative HTTP API contract
Get the agent API bootstrap guide
get.description: Anonymous stable Markdown navigation guide. Dynamic Task discovery remains in the task-type JSON APIs.

post.description: Exchange a username or email address and password for a time-limited Bearer token. Copy the response token into the Authorize dialog.

get.description: Reports the server-owned registration switch and email-service availability without exposing deployment configuration.

post.description: Requires registration and email delivery to be enabled, a valid CAPTCHA, profile fields, and Terms acceptance. The account remains subject to email verification and administrator approval.
Always uses generic success wording so the response does not reveal whether the email is registered.

post.summary: Reset a password with an emailed token
post.description: Validates the opaque signed token, its one-hour expiry, user identity, and token version before changing the password and invalidating prior session and reset tokens.
Uses generic wording for non-actionable accounts and enforces per-address backoff.

429.description: Verification resend backoff or rate limit active

post.summary: Verify an email address with an emailed token
post.description: Validates the opaque signed token and its two-day expiry, then records email verification. Administrator approval remains a separate account state.

get.summary: Get the canonical Terms of Service
get.description: Returns the bounded repository-owned Markdown source and a content-derived version. Clients must treat Markdown as text and render it without enabling arbitrary HTML.

Returns the long-lived operational notices a deployment has configured. Each notice body is plain text that clients must render without enabling arbitrary HTML. An empty list means there is nothing to announce.

post.description: Clear the auth cookie for the caller. A request authenticated with a Bearer token or API key also invalidates every token for the current user. A cookie-authenticated request is rejected with 403 unless it also presents a Bearer token (CSRF gate).

get.summary: Get the current browser or API session identity
get.description: Accepts the same HttpOnly session cookie, Bearer token, or API key as other authenticated reads. A missing, expired, or invalid credential returns the generic 401 response.

put.summary: Update the current user's profile or password
put.description: Requires a browser-session Bearer token. Profile fields are validated by the server. Password changes require both the current and new password and invalidate existing credentials.

get.summary: Mint an in-memory Bearer token for a browser session
get.description: Accepts a same-origin session cookie or existing Bearer token. API keys cannot be exchanged for the stronger web-session credential.

post.summary: Create or replace the current user's API key

delete.summary: Revoke the current user's API key

200.description: Ordered scientific categories and enabled task summaries
One method's scientific, access, input, and workspace contract; parameters_url identifies the canonical parameter schema

get.summary: Get an approved input-workspace plugin descriptor
get.description: Returns only server-approved same-origin assets for one installed Runner plugin. The module is an ES module and every asset URL is allowlisted by the installed plugin manifest.

get.summary: Get an approved input-workspace plugin asset
get.description: Authenticated delivery for an exact asset declared by the installed plugin descriptor. Undeclared and traversal paths are concealed as not found.

200.description: Approved JavaScript, CSS, or JSON asset

get.description: Returns the Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema declared under parameters in the enabled TaskType's owning task.yaml. This route is anonymous and is the canonical machine-readable parameter reference.

200.description: Current user's policy-level Runner access states

get.summary: Get current infrastructure readiness and capacity
get.description: Returns a safe grouped projection for authenticated users. Administrators also receive component evidence. Infrastructure readiness is independent from Runner readiness and transient capacity.

post.description: Admin-only manual execution of all bounded infrastructure probes.

get.summary: Get the current user's canonical resource envelope
get.description: The canonical per-subject position: compute entitlement and durable-storage ownership in base units. Placement and reporting consume this projection rather than re-deriving a balance. A unit with enforced false is recorded and reported but not gated.

get.summary: Get one user's canonical resource envelope
Get current user's GPU credit balance and history
get.description: Credits reset to the monthly grant at each UTC calendar-month boundary with no rollover. One credit is 60 GPU-seconds. Queue and CPU time are not charged.

200.description: Current user's monthly balance and immutable entries

get.summary: Get the current user's own Task metrics
get.description: Read-only aggregation over the authenticated user's persisted Tasks only. One window parameter selects the span and the activity bucket period; the endpoint never reports another user's Tasks.

200.description: Self-scoped Task aggregates for the selected window

get.summary: Get one user's GPU credit accounting

post.summary: Append an audited GPU credit adjustment
post.description: Adds a compensating ledger entry. Existing grants, usage, and adjustments cannot be edited or deleted. Identical retries reuse the original entry.

201.description: Adjustment appended or identical retry resolved

409.description: Idempotency key conflicts with a different adjustment

put.summary: Set one user's monthly GPU allowance
put.description: Updates the future grant policy and appends an immutable delta for the current UTC month. Identical retries reuse the original entry.

200.description: Allowance set or identical retry resolved

409.description: Idempotency key conflicts with a different allowance

post.summary: Reset one user's current-period GPU credits to their allowance
post.description: Appends one `admin_reset` ledger entry so the user's current-period remaining balance equals their effective monthly allowance (in either direction). Usage and prior adjustments are never modified or deleted, and GPU permission is unchanged. An already-at-allowance balance reports changed=false and appends a durable zero-value marker that reserves the idempotency key. Identical retries reuse the original entry.

200.description: Reset appended, no-op reported, or identical retry resolved

409.description: Idempotency key conflicts with a different reset

post.summary: Reset every current user's current-period GPU credits to their own allowance
post.description: Applies the reset independently to every current non-deleted account, respecting per-user allowance overrides and leaving GPU permission unchanged. All per-user entries are written in one transaction and share one batch identifier; identical retries append nothing.

409.description: Idempotency key conflicts with a different reset

get.summary: List GPU allocations awaiting settlement or review

post.summary: Reconcile GPU usage from retained Slurm controller evidence
post.description: Settles a lost GPU finish callback with one best-effort `scontrol show job <jobid>` query. Terminal controller state plus a trustworthy runtime settles usage; anything ambiguous is marked for review. No `sacct`/SlurmDBD accounting dependency.

200.description: Reconciliation result and remaining unsettled allocations

post.summary: Request access to a declared Runner policy

201.description: All missing entitlement request records created atomically

409.description: Policy access is already granted or all missing requests are pending

post.summary: Apply a user lifecycle action in batch

200.description: Policy-centric counts of granted, pending, and suspended users
Authorized, pending, suspended users and bounded activity

post.summary: Clear a user's Runner policy cooldown

200.description: Cooldown state cleared without granting entitlement

get.description: Authenticated progressive discovery. COLD runtime families remain available and start on first demand.

post.description: Uploads and same-user completed Task artifacts must be bound to named Tool input roles. Idempotency-Key is scoped to the authenticated user and Tool while the ephemeral call exists.

parameters.description: JSON-encoded parameter object validated against the Tool schema.

file_roles.description: Named role corresponding to each uploaded file.

202.description: Tool call queued, or existing idempotent call returned

429.description: Outstanding-call admission limit reached; Retry-After is provided.

507.description: Ephemeral Tool storage cannot be reclaimed safely.

get.summary: Get one owned Tool call status
get.description: The caller must already know the ephemeral call ID. There is no Tool call history/list API.

get.summary: Get one owned Tool result manifest

422.description: Call failed with a machine-readable error class

post.description: Submit uploads explicitly bound to named task input roles. Runner parameters are flat string fields named params[parameter_name]. The optional workspace field is a JSON-encoded version-2 workspace document. Accepted responses include the stable task ID and links for status and result discovery; Location also points to the status endpoint.

202.description: An identical task is already queued or running

302.description: Task accepted; Location points to its status endpoint

429.description: Submission rate limit or restricted Runner cooldown active; Retry-After contains integer seconds

post.summary: Validate a prospective task without creating it
post.description: Runs the same Core security, task contract, and current admission checks as submission. It does not create a Task, persist uploaded bytes, consume GPU credits, or enqueue work.

200.description: Security, contract, and admission checks passed

429.description: Preflight rate limit, concurrency policy, or restricted Runner cooldown active

get.description: Ordinary users receive their own non-deleted Tasks. Administrators receive every non-deleted Task and its owner. Values are domain state and capabilities rather than presentation labels.

200.description: Visible Tasks in descending submission order
Visible terminal task status, including failures; failed tasks return 200 so URL clients can reconstruct their terminal state, while missing or concealed tasks return 404

202.description: Task is pending, queued, running, or cleaning up

404.description: Task does not exist or is not visible to the current session

409.description: Task cleanup is already in progress

200.description: Finalized result manifest and archive state

302.description: Task is not terminal; Location points to its status endpoint

404.description: Result does not exist, is not finalized, is not readable, or is not visible to the current session. A terminal task whose result exists but is not a readable publication returns a bounded `result_publication` state in the body (`unanchored` for a result finalized before server-owned publication identity existed, `anchor_mismatch` for a manifest replaced after publication) with the reason in `message`.

get.description: Only files published by the finalized result manifest are available. Artifacts default to attachment; set download=0 to request inline delivery under the server sandbox policy.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Slash-preserving artifact path from the manifest

get.summary: Download a declared logical result file
get.description: Resolves a logical expected-file identity and index through the finalized manifest; clients do not construct filesystem paths.

get.summary: Get the declared Runner Storyboard module
get.description: Serves only the deployment-controlled Storyboard entrypoint declared by the task type, never task output code.

get.summary: Read one complete bounded result projection
get.description: Parses or decompresses a manifest-approved source once and returns the complete selected projection or rejects it. JSON selectors are bounded dot-separated object fields and non-negative array indices. Numeric JSON scalars use shape [] and one flattened data value. Categorical projections are tightly bounded JSON/CSV/TSV string vectors; NPY and NPZ remain numeric-only.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Slash-preserving JSON/CSV/TSV/NPY/NPZ artifact path from the manifest

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Required bounded JSON path, CSV/TSV column, or NPZ array key

parameters.name: max_elements
parameters.description: Caller ceiling; the request fails rather than returning a partial projection when the selected value is larger.

200.description: Complete bounded projection and storage-neutral metadata

get.description: Reads a manifest-approved CSV or TSV artifact with bounded rows, columns, and cell lengths.

409.description: Task results are not ready, or the published result is not readable. A quarantined result (`result_publication` of `unanchored`, `anchor_mismatch`, `manifest_missing`, `manifest_unreadable`, or `anchor_invalid`) cannot be packed into a new archive; the body carries the state and the reason.

The optional archive has not been requested, or the published result is not readable. A quarantined result (`result_publication` of `unanchored`, `anchor_mismatch`, `manifest_missing`, `manifest_unreadable`, or `anchor_invalid`) is never served as an archive, not even a previously cached one; the body carries the state and the reason.

get.summary: List fleet readiness, capacity, access, and in-flight jobs

200.description: Every enabled Runner family's admin projection

get.summary: Read one Runner family's evidence and permitted actions

200.description: The family's readiness, capacity, access, evidence, and actions

post.summary: Plan one typed operator action without executing it

200.description: The content-addressed plan, including the operations it will not perform

post.summary: Execute a previously planned typed operator action
post.description: The plan digest binds execution to the evidence the plan was computed against; if that evidence changed, the request is rejected with 409 stale_plan rather than executed against new state.

202.description: The mutation was accepted as a durable Operator Job

200.description: A read action ran inline, or an idempotent replay returned the existing job

409.description: Stale plan, or a conflicting operation holds the family lease

get.summary: Read the bounded operator history for one Runner family

200.description: Newest-first operator history with requested intent and effective actions

get.summary: Read one Operator Job's status, stage, log, and effect

post.summary: Request cancellation of an owned Operator Job

409.description: The job is no longer cancellable

cookieAuth.name: auth_token
cookieAuth.description: Same-origin HttpOnly browser session cookie set by POST /compute/api/auth/login.

apiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
apiKeyAuth.description: Long-lived key created from the REvoCompute Profile page.

RunnerFamily.name: runner_family
RunnerFamily.description: Canonical Runner family identifier resolved from the registry.

Unavailable.description: Server, queue, or task policy unavailable

TaskParameterSchema.description: Draft 2020-12 parameter schema projected without modification from the owning task.yaml

ComputeEntitlement.description: One (unit, resource class) entitlement and its position. remaining already subtracts settled usage, live admission holds, and the conservative reserve for usage whose authoritative measurement has not arrived, so unsettled_allocations plus usage_complete false means the true balance is not yet known - never that it is zero.

resource_class.description: Slurm GRES class (for example a100); empty for the class-agnostic allowance.

allowance.description: Null when the unit is not gated.

StorageEntitlement.description: Logical user-owned durable bytes, tracked separately from physical filesystem capacity. A successful computation that crosses soft_limit_bytes keeps its result; only later admission is restricted.

ResourceEntitlement.description: The canonical per-subject resource position that downstream consumers project.

display_name.description: Safe basename of the primary submitted input.

terminal.description: Whether pollers should expect no further lifecycle transition.

owner.description: Username for administrator listings; null for ordinary users.

placement.description: The execution class recorded when the Task was submitted, read from its frozen decision rather than recomputed. Null when the Task predates recorded decisions.

id.description: Stable operator-facing identity of the class, so two decisions that selected the same class compare equal.

partition.description: The deployment-local queue the resolved request names.

device_class.description: Accelerator class the GRES request named; null when untyped.

publication.description: Publication state of the task's result. "available" is the only state whose manifest may be requested through manifest_url; every other state names why the result is not readable. "unanchored" is the state of results finalized before server-owned publication identity existed; "anchor_mismatch" means the manifest on disk is no longer the one Core published.

files.description: Input files; requirements depend on the selected task type.

input_roles.description: Role ID corresponding positionally to each multipart files part.

input_paths.description: Optional relative paths corresponding to files, used by multi-file task types.

task_type.description: Enabled task-type name from GET /compute/api/types; omitted when it is supplied by the request path.

display_name.description: Safe basename of the task's primary submitted filename for running and terminal headers.

terminal.description: True when no further status transition is coming and pollers should stop: finished, failed, cancelled, cleaned:*, deleted:*. False while a transition may still follow: pending, queued, running, deleting:*. Pollers read this flag instead of mirroring the status vocabulary.

result_available.description: True only when the finalized manifest currently exists and may be requested through results_url.

result_publication.description: Publication state of the task's result; null when no task row is visible. A terminal task whose results are not readable reports the state that explains it (for example "unanchored" for a result finalized before server-owned publication identity existed) rather than only result_available=false. The same state vocabulary is reported on the results endpoint's 404 body.

task_status.description: Current execution state when status retains a legacy compatibility message

table_url.description: Bounded table-page URL when the artifact is declared table-capable.

ndarray_url.description: Bounded numeric projection URL for JSON, CSV, TSV, NPY, and NPZ artifacts.

capability.description: Generic rendering capability. Consumers fall back to download for unknown and download_only.

table_url.description: Bounded table-page URL when the logical file is declared as a table.

ArrayProjection.description: A complete bounded projection. Numeric projections contain at most 1,048,576 elements and 8 MiB of decoded fixed-width data. Categorical projections contain at most 1,048,576 strings, 64 UTF-8 bytes per string, and 4 MiB of aggregate UTF-8 string data.

dtype.description: NumPy fixed-width numeric dtype including byte order.

items.description: At most 64 UTF-8 bytes; maxLength is an additional character-count ceiling.

TablePage.description: A table page whose complete compact JSON response is limited to 8 MiB. Each cell is limited to 16 KiB of UTF-8 data; row, column, and cell maxima are subordinate to the aggregate response limit.

items.description: At most 16 KiB of UTF-8 data; maxLength is an additional character-count ceiling.
At most 16 KiB of UTF-8 data; maxLength is an additional character-count ceiling.

recovery_action.description: The most scientifically impactful automatic recovery action this item took; empty when the default path ran.

recovery.description: Per-attempt requested-versus-effective provenance, newest attempts first when the list is trimmed.

RecoveryRecord.description: One attempt's adaptive-OOM provenance: the plan applied, its scientific-impact class, the resource-only settings it changed, and the effective parameter set the attempt executed.

action.description: The attempt's recovery-action class; empty for the default path.

resources.description: The resource-only settings this attempt applied (never a scientific parameter).

effective_parameters.description: The effective parameter set the attempt executed; compare with the task's requested parameters to see any divergence.

error.description: Sanitized terminal failure message when status is failed.

outcome.description: Runner-owned standardized aggregate outcome; PARTIAL_SUCCESS remains a finished task.

RunnerReadinessStatus.description: The derived six-state Runner readiness verdict. Never set directly.

RunnerEvidence.description: The content-addressed evidence a readiness verdict was derived from.

reason_code.description: Stable machine-readable reason; clients localize the copy.

RunnerCapacity.description: Transient execution availability, reported separately from readiness.

RunnerFleetAccess.description: Whether the calling user may submit to a restricted family; separate from readiness.

OperatorPlan.description: A deterministic, content-addressed plan produced before any privileged execution.

cli_reference.description: Read-only reference text; never an execution mechanism.

OperatorAction.description: One entry of the closed operator-action registry, with its plan when currently available.

OperatorJobEffect.description: What the operator requested versus what the control core actually executed.

OperatorJob.description: A bounded Operator Job record. No host paths or raw environment are exposed.

OperatorExecutorState.description: Host executor availability, a capability separate from Runner readiness.

accepted.description: False when an idempotent replay returned the existing job.
